$$
z\leq\sqrt{x^2+y^2}\leq\sqrt{3z}\quad \text{原式}=\int_0^2\left[z^2\iint_{x^2+y^2\leq2z-z^2}dxdy\right]dz
$$

$$
=\int_0^2\pi z^2(2z-z^2)dz
$$

$$
=\frac{8}{5}\pi
$$
